alt: A smiling woman with long dark hair stands next to a large portrait of Albert Einstein created from a grid of toasted marshmallows.

A grid of toasted marshmallows arranged to form a mosaic portrait of the Cheshire Cat, featuring its signature wide grin and striped body, with the initials "KMS" branded into the bottom center square.
A smiling woman with long dark hair stands beside two large vertical panels of toasted marshmallows arranged to create pixelated portraits of an owl and a dog.
